chief_complaint: Management of hypertension and obesity with associated cardiovascular risk
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 42-year-old white male with a history of essential hypertension diagnosed in 2016, currently treated with lisinopril 10 mg daily. Blood pressure at the most recent measurement was 132/86 mmHg (stage 1 hypertension). He has obesity (BMI ≥30) documented since 2010 and obstructive sleep apnea diagnosed in 2014, without recorded CPAP therapy. He reports limited social contact and is employed full‑time. Over the past decade he has had predominantly wellness visits (9 of 13 total), two inpatient encounters, and no emergency visits. Laboratory data (lipids, glucose, renal function) and lifestyle information (smoking, alcohol, physical activity) are missing, limiting full risk assessment.

The patient also had a resolved medication review due flag in earlier years.
